### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>moby/sys (github.com/moby/sys/user)</summary>

### [`v0.5.0`](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/releases/tag/user/v0.5.0)

#### Breaking changes

##### `IdentityMapping.ToHost` no longer special-cases the remapped root

`ToHost` used to skip the ID-map lookup when the ID passed in was equal to the
host remapped-root ID (as returned by `RootPair`). This was wrong: the arguments
are *container* IDs, and comparing them against a *host* value made no sense.

With a subuid/subgid base below 65536 (for example `rootless:1000:65536`, used
to align dind-rootless container UIDs), a non-root container UID equal to the
base (`1000` in this example) was returned unmapped, so it appeared as root
inside the container.

`ToHost` now always translates both UID and GID through the mappings.
Container root (`0`) still maps to the host remapped-root base, same as
`RootPair` returns. An empty (nil) mapping is treated as identity.

What this means for callers:

- Pass container IDs only. Code that passes the host remapped-root pair (for
  example, the result of `RootPair`) to `ToHost` and expects it back unchanged
  gets a different result or an error now. Pass `0, 0` instead, or use
  `RootPair` directly.
- If `ToHost` returns an error, both returned IDs are now `-1`. Previously
  they could hold a partially translated value.

The only known caller that was relying on old behavior was moby/moby;
it was fixed by [moby/moby#53859](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53859).

See [#​242](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/issues/242) and [#​241](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/issues/241).

##### Windows: `MkdirAndChown` no longer creates parent directories

On Windows, `MkdirAndChown` used to call `os.MkdirAll`, so it also created any
missing parent directories, unlike on Unix. It now uses `os.Mkdir`, as
documented. Use `MkdirAllAndChown` if you need parent directories created. See
[#​236](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/issues/236).

#### Changes

- user: GetExecUser: use strings.Cut to split user:group ([#​228](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/pull/228))
- user: GetExecUser: always clone default Sgids ([#​229](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/pull/229))
- user: GetExecUser: rewrite with parseUserArg, parseGroupArg ([#​231](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/pull/231), [#​232](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/pull/232))
- user: parseNumeric: require non-empty values ([#​235](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/pull/235))
- user: MkdirAllAndChown, MkdirAndChown: DRY ([#​244](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/pull/244))
- user: GoDoc fixes ([#​233](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/pull/233), [#​237](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/pull/237))
- user: test fixes and cleanups ([#​227](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/pull/227), [#​234](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/pull/234))
- user: require Go 1.24 ([#​272](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/pull/272))
